# Verify calling rtc-inject twice does not break monitoring.
# The helper script guards against double-injection with __cdpst_rtc_initialized.
rtc-inject
rtc-inject
navigate /webrtc-loopback.html
wait-visible '#status'
rtc-wait connected 60s
rtc-peers
stdout 'count:'
stdout 'connected'
rtc-state
stdout 'connected'
